purpose: Form NCLT-9 is used for applications under section 245, certain references and complaints to the Tribunal, applications for inspection of minute-books of general meetings, and applications for withdrawal under section 241.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the application in Form NCLT-9.
File the application with the Tribunal.
Serve a copy of the application on the company, other respondents, and persons directed by the Tribunal.
checklist: Verify requisite number of members or depositors if filing under section 245.
Attach documents mentioned in Annexure-B if required by the reference type.
Ensure the application is in Form NCLT-9.
watch: Ensure all required service copies are sent to the company and other respondents as directed.
